description: Vet-reviewed homemade dog-treat recipes organised by food allergen.

authors.name: Dr. Sarah Jenkins
authors.bio: Dr. Sarah Jenkins is a licensed veterinarian specializing in canine nutrition and allergen-friendly diets.

authors.name: DogSnacker Editorial Team
authors.bio: We develop and test homemade dog treat recipes, focusing on minimal ingredients for sensitive dogs.

editorial.testing: Every recipe is developed in-house, tested by our team's dogs, and reviewed by a licensed veterinarian for nutritional safety and allergen accuracy.
editorial.monetization: We earn a commission if you purchase recommended ingredients or kitchen tools through our affiliate links, and we sell digital recipe collections.
editorial.corrections: If a recipe ingredient is flagged for safety or updated veterinary guidance, we will update the post immediately and note the correction at the top of the page.
